metadata.title: Juice to boost immunity sold in Tribal Market in Tripura | त्रिपुरा का आदिवासी  हाट
metadata.description: Main Bhi Bharat team is travelling to the state of Tripura to meet the people of different tribal communities.Like all other tribal groups in the world, the tribal people of Tripura are rich in cultural folklore which has been handed down from generation to generation and is facing challenges of extinction due to modern waves of life. These have also created an ethnic identity crisis among them. We are bringing many ground reports from Tripura. Today we will take you to a local weekly tribal bazaar in Siphaijala district.
